Fort Walton Beach non-profits ranked by government grant revenue in 2024
Liza Jackson Preparatory School Inc led non-profits in Fort Walton Beach, Florida in reported government grant revenue in 2024, with $10,655,737 in government grants reported in its IRS Form 990 filing and $11,702,030 in total revenue. Government grants made up 91.1% of its reported total revenue.
The ranking reflects non-profits with available Form 990-series government grant revenue data that met the ranking's data criteria and may not include every non-profit in the city.
The ranking is based on IRS Form 990 filings, the annual information returns most tax-exempt organizations file with the IRS. The form includes reported revenue, expenses, assets, governance information and compensation paid to certain people, making it a public source for comparing large tax-exempt organizations' finances.
The figures reflect what each organization reported for its filing year, including total revenue, contributions, government grants, compensation, the number of employees and assets at the start and end of the year. Because nonprofits can differ by mission, structure and accounting period, the totals are best read as reported financial measures, not as a direct measure of local charitable activity.
Among the 10 ranked organizations with calculable government-grant shares, the median share of revenue from government grants was 41.1%. Okaloosa Walton Homeless Continuum Of Care Opportunity Inc reported the highest share, with government grants making up 97.8% of its total revenue.
In 2024, Liza Jackson Preparatory School Inc reported $10,655,737 in government grants, up from $10,424,379 the previous year, an increase of $231,358 or 2.2%. Okaloosa Walton Homeless Continuum Of Care Opportunity Inc reported $2,258,781 in government grants, up from $1,398,649, an increase of $860,132 or 61.5%. Boys And Girls Clubs Of The Emerald Coast Inc, however, reported $1,864,005 in government grants, a decrease from $2,407,407 the previous year.
Liza Jackson Preparatory School Inc reported total contributions of $10,774,816 in 2024, of which $119,079 was categorized as all other contributions. Okaloosa Walton Homeless Continuum Of Care Opportunity Inc reported total contributions of $2,309,946, including $46,176 as all other contributions. Boys And Girls Clubs Of The Emerald Coast Inc reported $4,698,571 in total contributions in the same year, with $2,834,566 as all other contributions and $1,096,496 reported as non-cash contributions. Asset balances changed for several organizations, including Liza Jackson Preparatory School Inc, whose assets rose 0.3% from $28,182,658 at the beginning of the year to $28,265,722 at year end.
Tax-exempt organizations include a wide range of groups, such as charities, foundations, educational institutions and other mission-driven organizations. Under IRS rules, 501(c)(3) organizations must be organized and operated for exempt purposes, and their earnings cannot benefit private shareholders or individuals.
